import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem countable_basis_compact_closure_subset {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  (x : X) (B : ℕ → Set X)
  (hBopen : ∀ n, IsOpen (B n)) (hxB : ∀ n, x ∈ B n)
  (hBbasis : ∀ s ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ n, B n ⊆ s)
  (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
  ∃ n : ℕ, IsOpen (B n) ∧ x ∈ B n ∧ IsCompact (closure (B n)) ∧ closure (B n) ⊆ U := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK_nhds, hKU, hK_comp⟩ := LocallyCompactSpace.local_compact_nhds x U (hU.mem_nhds hxU)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hBbasis K hK_nhds
  have h_sub : closure (B n) ⊆ K := closure_minimal hn hK_comp.isClosed
  exact ⟨n, hBopen n, hxB n, hK_comp.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure h_sub, h_sub.trans hKU⟩
